title: Phone Number Config Flow Builder
description: Configuration settings for configuring a Phone Number for the Voice FlowBuilder Application.

phoneNumber.description: The Phone Number that the current configuration applies to.

appAccountGuid.description: The unique identifier of the application can be found in the Voice Management App in the API Settings section.

type.description: The Application type that should be used. Can be either `directforwarding`, `flowbuilder`, `notification`, `sip`, `halo` or `none`.

callFlowId.description: Unique Identifier of the callflow that should be used. Can be found in the Voice FlowBuilder application.
